faq.q: Does converting to JPG remove transparency?
faq.a: Yes. JPG does not support transparency. If your source image has transparency, consider using PNG or WebP instead.
WebP typically provides 25-35% smaller file sizes than JPG at equivalent quality, with support for transparency and animation. It is supported by all modern browsers.
PNG, WebP (lossless), and BMP conversions preserve quality. JPG and WebP (lossy) involve some compression and may reduce quality slightly.
